item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - The Unauthorized Beverly Hills 90210 Story (2015)
item.description:
I'm looking for a decent bitrate copy of the Unauthorized Beverly Hills 90210 Story which was shown on LIFE in 2015.

It may exist in someone's archive at 1080i HDTV 384Kbps AC3. This is the original quality and it would be great if someone has this to post.

These are some of the better releases:
The Unauthorized Beverly Hills 90210 Story.2015.720p.HDTV.x264_TTL
2.7GB and ~4.2Mbps on pub BT with no seeders, but several folks with metadata

The.Unauthorized.Beverly.Hills.90210.Story.2015.720p.LIFE.WEBRip.AAC2.0.H.264-BTW.mkv
1.6GB and ~2.5Mbps on pub BT but stuck at 99.9% (one block missing). The quality is quite good.

The.Unauthorized.Beverly.Hills.90210.Story.720p.HDTV.x264-TASTETV
3.7Mbps and was on USENET in 2015

I checked various other file sharing sites, slsk, all the well known file hosts, but if it's there it's been renamed to something non-obvious. None of the private trackers I'm a member of have it or have a poor bitrate with artifacts.

There are a few low bitrate low quality versions on various other sites.

If you can stream capture with yt-dlp and keys, Philo may have this in 4 to 8 Mbps 1080p (they have a free trial period). USA only atm. Do search Reddit first for Philo captures (can be tricky). If no one already has the video, I may try this route.
Amazon has it with Prime, but that capture method is only known to a few in the scene.

Of special note is the actress Samantha Munro who played Brenda in the Unauthorized video. I was taken by her striking blue eyes and looked her up. There's a whole other high school / college show called Degrassi The Next Generation. More modern and intense content that would never make it past USA broadcast censors.

Degrassi TNG is part of a large franchise of related/similar shows and was produced/broadcast in Canada. It's most like The O.C. but better IMO. I've only watched season 7 and I'm quite hooked. Samantha's character Anya stars in several of the later seasons. Apparently shes goes from a goody-goody to a cocaine party girl and bad stuff happens (I haven't watched yet). Anyway...check it out. And please share the Unauthorized BH90210 video if you have it complete and a decent bitrate.
